name: Nguyen Hue
role: The Tây Sơn commander who drove Nguyễn Ánh out of the south and later ruled as Emperor Quang Trung.
known_facts: One of the three Tây Sơn brothers who rose in 1771.
Commanded Tây Sơn forces that took Gia Định in 1777 and again in 1782.
Destroyed the Siamese fleet at Rạch Gầm–Xoài Mút in January 1785.
Proclaimed himself Emperor Quang Trung in 1788.
Defeated the Qing army at Ngọc Hồi–Đống Đa in early 1789.
Died in September 1792, leaving a young heir and a divided court.
interpretation: Apparent age mid-thirties, broad-shouldered and compact, square jaw, deep-set dark eyes, thick eyebrows, full moustache and short beard; black hair in a topknot under a dark red cloth turban; wears a dark red padded war coat with iron studs over a brown tunic, leather arm guards, a wide cloth sash, and a long sword in a black lacquered scabbard.
